title: Maker post analysis
description: Structured output the LLM returns for each Reddit post. Every downstream step (review queue, analytics, dashboard) reads these fields.

high_intent.description: Does the author show real intent to make a physical object?

intent_score.description: Strength of maker intent combined with workflow frustration.

object_goal.description: What the author is trying to make, e.g. 'custom headphone mount'.

workflow_blocker.description: The specific thing stopping them, e.g. 'Fusion 360 confusion'.

printer_owner_likelihood.description: How likely the author already owns a 3D printer, e.g. 'very_likely'.

response_recommended.description: Should a reply be drafted at all? False for commission requests, off-topic posts, etc.

reply_draft.description: Short, community-native reply. Empty when no response is recommended.

needs_human_review.description: Route to the review queue: high uncertainty, sensitive or personal topics, competitor mentions, commission requests.

review_reason.description: Why the post was flagged. Empty when not flagged.
